findings.text: AC-2 asks a property over field combinations; only one contradicting-stance example exists. tests/test_verdict_scripts.py:915
findings.consequence: Whoever changes the recap next has no guard telling them a seat-written field must never move the printed verb. A human reading a Gate 2 recap could be told the opposite of the call that was made, and nothing in the suite would have caught it first.

findings.text: Cap assertion counts non-empty lines only; blank lines untested against the 40-line cap. tests/test_verdict_scripts.py:940
findings.consequence: A human reading a crowded verdict could get a block taller than the cap promises, pushing the line that says how to answer off the visible screen. The suite cannot rule that out as written.
